column3: Thought it could be a good chance to catch up, given that we haven't talked since I nearly fell into a black hole that resulted from your escapade with a world-ending organization...
You know, normal parent-child bonding stuff...

We are not here as parent and child.
We are here as equals-- both professional representatives of an official league, working to ensure the safety of our region.
SERRA: Equals, the newest Elite says to a humble mid-tier Gym Leader...
BENNETT: Yes.
Equals, with equal respect.
SERRA: Professionals.
Not family?
BENNETT: Both can be true,
With equal respect.
Consider it.
SERRA: I'm confused--
Oh, bye.
SERRA: ...Have I not been respectful???
